about.label: Get to know me
about.title: About
about.subtitle: FullStack Developer passionate about building performant, maintainable and user-centred digital solutions.
about.bio_p1: I'm Raoudha Fathallah, a FullStack Developer with over 4 years of experience designing and building web and mobile applications. My journey has taken me from complex ERP projects to modern SaaS platforms, always with a focus on quality and performance.
about.bio_p2: Specialised in the Microsoft ecosystem (.NET Core, .NET 8, C#, Blazor) on the backend, and in modern frameworks (Angular, React, Next.js) on the frontend, I work across all stages of the software lifecycle: design, development, testing and deployment. I've contributed to transport management (WMS/TMS/CRM), ERP, production planning (GPAO) and online seminar platforms.
about.bio_p3: Curious and self-driven, I stay constantly up to date with technology. I work in Agile/Scrum methodology and place great importance on communication and team collaboration. My goal: turning complex business needs into elegant digital experiences.
